title: Accept your invitation
subtitle: Choose a password to activate your account and open the workspace.

invalid.title: Invitation not valid
invalid.text: This invitation has expired or was already used. If you already set your password, sign in.
invalid.askAdmin: Otherwise, ask your administrator to send a new invitation.

errors.sessionLimit: Your account is active, but you have too many open sessions. Sign out on another device, then sign in.
errors.AUTH_MFA_UNAVAILABLE: Your account is active, but two-step verification is not available right now. Sign in again shortly.
errors.ambiguous: The connection was lost. Your account may already be active; if the next try says the invitation is not valid, sign in.
